name: 19562 · Topton, PA
findings: ZIP 19562 (Topton) has 13 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (62%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19562 (Topton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 19562 (Topton) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 9.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 8% of all organizations here have no identified type.
